# varnish_cdn_domain_dns (Data Source)

Live DNS verification settings for a single service domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "varnish_cdn_domain_dns" "api" {
  service_id = varnish_cdn_service.web.id
  fqdn       = "api.example.com"
}

# Wire the expected records into your DNS provider, e.g.:
output "expected_cname" {
  value = data.varnish_cdn_domain_dns.api.expected_cname
}

output "expected_txt" {
  value = data.varnish_cdn_domain_dns.api.expected_txt
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fqdn` (String) Domain FQDN to look up.
- `service_id` (String) Service identifier.

### Read-Only

- `a_records` (List of String) A records found in DNS.
- `cdn_routed` (Boolean) Whether the domain is effectively routed to the CDN.
- `cname` (String) CNAME found in DNS.
- `domain_id` (String) Server-assigned domain identifier.
- `expected_a_records` (List of String) Expected A/AAAA records.
- `expected_acme_cname` (String) Expected ACME CNAME.
- `expected_cname` (String) Expected CNAME (the generated CDN domain).
- `expected_txt` (String) Expected TXT record (verification token).
- `is_apex` (Boolean) Whether the domain is an apex domain.
- `subdomain` (String) Subdomain portion, if any.
- `txt_records` (List of String) TXT records found in DNS.
- `valid_a` (Boolean) Whether the A record is valid.
- `valid_acme_cname` (Boolean) Whether the ACME CNAME record is valid.
- `valid_cname` (Boolean) Whether the CNAME record is valid.
- `valid_txt` (Boolean) Whether the TXT record is valid.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether the domain is verified.
